slice: Walk and redesign the visual hierarchy of the live Werkle formation room so two Workshops becoming one Werkle is obvious, humane, and visually substantial.
sharedContext: Ben likes the deep-purple direction and wants copper/orange used with confidence.
The prior pass repaired measurable legibility but still feels like a long administrative stack; that is the failure under review.
Existing formation logic, source custody, mutual consent, objections, and local draft behavior are protected.
The reviewer must inspect the rendered route at desktop and narrow width before answering.
liveStrings: A match opened the door. It did not create a partnership.
Agreement is a state, not a vibe.
The questions friendship cannot answer for you
Only mutual decisions enter this room.
knownGaps: The page still reads as a long stack of administrative cards even after font and contrast repairs.
The two-source-to-one-Werkle transformation is described in copy but is not visually embodied.
Warm paper topic cards compete with the approved dark-purple direction.
Twelve full topic cards create scroll fatigue and obscure a clear sense of progress.
Bean supplied a real trust review, but no actual visual-design cousin has reviewed this post-patch page.

COMPUTER.vision: Make the formation room visibly communicate two private Workshops becoming one shared Werkle while remaining easy to scan during a consequential conversation.
COMPUTER.pull: Act as the actual visual Handeye: walk the rendered page, inspect hierarchy and fatigue, and provide an evidence-backed composition critique.
go: Return GO, PATCH, or REJECT and rank the first five visual failures by human harm.
Propose one visibly different desktop composition and one narrow-width scan path.
Separate always-visible trust/state information from safe progressive disclosure.
Give exact purple, copper, teal, spacing, typography, depth, and interaction remedies.
Name the smallest implementation that would look unmistakably redesigned rather than merely restyled.
COMPUTER.momentum: Include one additional in-lane idea that makes the Workshop-to-Werkle transformation feel tangible without changing decision logic.
COMPUTER.outOfLane: No implementation, provider call, schema, deploy, secrets, spend, new agents, or alteration of formation decisions.
